agent.result_text:
All cases work:
- Scalar `x` with default `keep_attrs` (resolved from global option) no longer crashes
- Scalar `x` with explicit `keep_attrs=True` returns empty attrs instead of crashing
- DataArray `x` with `keep_attrs=True` still correctly preserves attributes

The fix adds a length check on the `attrs` list before indexing — when `x` is a scalar (no `.attrs`), `apply_ufunc` produces a shorter `attrs` list, so we fall back to an empty dict instead of raising `IndexError`.
